title: hc_monster_ai custom receipt preservation
baseline: native53/native54 freezes retained; production helper pre-fix
finding: finish() wrote a constant outputs/hc_monster_ai_package/name.json with WRITE, allowing later runs to truncate the original full checks and omitting run/source/engine/scene metadata.
disposition: Added separate_write_receipt(name) with per-support immutable nonce directory, atomic directory ownership, safe name filtering, collision rejection, complete business checks and source/engine/scene/run/invocation/native PID metadata; finish() reuses the same writer and still owns print/quit.

coverage: independent PASS and FAIL support instances

constraints: No production gameplay code or runner/compiler changed.
Legacy constant output path is no longer used by finish; no normal consumer was found requiring it.
Framework receipt remains separate from custom support receipts.
